d: I travelled from Istanbul to Pamukkale and had to take a bus from Istanbul Main bus station to Eskisehir, followed by a train to Denizli. However, as a foreigner, I encountered some challenges at the bus station in Istanbul. If you're planning to travel by bus in Turkey, I recommend watching this video for helpful tips on booking tickets online, securing the best seats, and learning about the amenities available on Turkish buses. You'll also get a glimpse of what the buses look like from the inside, find out how much tickets cost, and discover the cost of food at rest stops along the way.…
